name: Sausage, Shrimp & Cauliflower Rice Jambalaya Stew with Green Onions

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove sausages to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Combine spices in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp garlic powder
1 tbsp onion powder
2 tsp thyme
1 ½ tsp basil
1 ½ tsp oregano
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp black pepper
⅜ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice onions; add to the bowl with the spices.
Slice celery crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Seed and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Return the pot (with leftover oil from cooking) to medium-high heat. Add chopped veggies and spices from the bowl; cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, about 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut cauliflower heads into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the pot along with the cauliflower, broth, tomatoes, and tomato paste. Bring mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
3 tbsp tomato paste

instructions.primary_message: Slice sausages into ½-inch thick rounds; add back to the pot, along with the shrimp. Cook, stirring often, until shrimp are opaque and cauliflower is tender, about 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Stir half of the onions into the pot (reserve the rest for garnish).
To serve, divide jambalaya between bowls and top with remaining green onions. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
